topic: UX Strategy, Product Thinking, and Design Handoff
learningObjectives: Connect UX decisions with user needs and product objectives.
Prepare designs and specifications for development handoff.
Communicate design decisions clearly to cross-functional teams.

activities.title: UX Strategy Map
activities.instruction: Explore how user needs connect to product goals.

content.concept: UX strategy aligns user needs, business objectives, product constraints, and measurable outcomes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Product Decision Matcher
activities.instruction: Match product goals with relevant UX decisions.

content.concept: Design decisions should consider user value, product goals, technical constraints, and available evidence.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Developer Handoff Builder
activities.instruction: Assemble the essential parts of a design handoff.

content.concept: A useful handoff communicates layouts, dimensions, states, assets, interactions, responsive behavior, and design tokens.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Handoff Completeness Check
activities.instruction: Select the missing information in each handoff.

content.concept: Complete handoff documentation reduces ambiguity between designers and developers during implementation.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
